data.one_liner: Flutter PDF editor and viewer with native rendering and editing tools
data.what_it_does: Provides drop-in Flutter widgets for viewing, searching, annotating, filling forms, signing, and editing PDF documents natively in Dart. Supports text selection, page splitting, and document comparison without relying on platform views.
use_when: You need an embedded PDF viewer or full-featured editor inside a Flutter app.
You want custom UI chrome and cross-platform support including web without native PDF library dependencies.
avoid_when: You require absolute 100% PDFium interaction parity out-of-the-box for all complex edge cases.
You want to avoid downloading optional assets like bundled fonts and web workers for features requiring full-font fallback.
strengths: Complete suite of built-in annotation, redaction, digital signature, and form-filling tools.
Cross-platform support including web, iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, and Linux using pure-Dart rendering.
Low setup friction with drop-in widgets and flexible controllers.
weaknesses: Default viewer does not yet reach full PDFium interaction parity for some complex metrics.
Heavy asset requirements (bundled fonts and web worker) require an optional companion package for full fidelity.
data.setup_notes: Add the package via pub.dev and optionally register bundled assets at startup using dart_pdf_editor_assets if font substitution or web workers are needed.
